verdict.rationale: Unreal documents a command-line cook commandlet (UnrealEditor.exe <uproject> -run=cook -targetplatform=...) and the Unreal Automation Tool, described as a system to automate building games, including a command that cooks, packages, deploys and runs the project. This covers building and exporting without clicking through the editor. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a headless/no-display mode for builds or CI-server integration, so coverage is incomplete. missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless (no-GUI) build execution, CI pipeline integration guidance, the actual BuildCookRun command-line syntax, independent hands-on corroboration of CI builds.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can build and export the project from the command line, headless, in CI — no human clicking an editor

citations.quote: Unreal Automation Tool is a generic system used to automate processes, including testing and building games.
This command can cook content for a platform, package it up into a platform's native format for distribution, deploys it to the device, and automatically runs the project
